about: The S1-L1 situation table (D-090; design docs/research/findings/system1-context/DESIGN-2026-09-25.md L1). One row per situation: the tool input that detects it and the skill section whose key lines are injected verbatim before the call. Derived from CLAUDE.md's 'Load `<skill>` before/when <situation>' pointer lines and its other load rules; each row's `source` names the line. Detectors (all given ones must match): `command` (a regex at a shell command position), `command_any` (anywhere in the command), `path` / `path_not` (the repo-relative file path), `text` (the written text or the command). A `lines` entry is a substring naming one line of the section (the whole entry from that line is taken) or a [from, to] pair (the lines from one to the other). Rows are in priority order: under the byte budget the earlier row wins. The hook: .claude/hooks/system1-context.py; the tests: tests/test_system1_context.py.
